chunks: Say: 'Imagine if God takes away your hearing and sight, and sets a seal on your hearts, what deity other than God will restore them to you?' See how We inflect Our signs: Even then they turn aside.

key_terms.خَتَمَ عَلَى قُلُوبِكُمْ: set a seal on your hearts

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God's ability to seal the heart and remove human senses?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the concept of *Tawhid* by illustrating that sensory and cognitive faculties are not inherent but are divine gifts that can be withdrawn at will, leaving no other deity capable of restoration. The 'sealing of the heart' is often interpreted as a consequence of persistent rejection, serving as a rhetorical challenge to polytheists to identify any alternative source of such power. This underscores the practical implication that true recognition of God requires acknowledging His exclusive authority over both creation and perception.
